description:
##Let's Adventure!

##About
Join this 90 minute haunt & history walk to see the infamous grounds of one of America's oldest cities! 

- Walk the streets of the Boston Strangler, The Boston Massacre Site along  many other haunted locations. 

- The Boston Night Tour is led by the same historians who lead our Tour of The Freedom Trail. This is a must for visitors to The Bean Town. 

##More Information
**This tour is great for:**
- Families 
- Paranormal Investigators
- History Buffs
